name: Release-note feature block
purpose: Announces one headline capability of a release with a short pitch, a visual and a grid of the specific improvements it brings.
description: Repeated release-note block on /lms/spring-release (6 instances, alternating light #fafefe and page-black themes): a centred header (optional green 'New' pill, H2 with one italic word, body copy, optional button), an optional visual (a 150px looping-video strip under the header, or a product screenshot placed above or below the grid), a 4-column grid of feature items (bold title + text, optionally a customer credit with a 44px avatar; 2 cols <=991, stacked <=479 or <=767 for the wide grid), and an optional big 32px customer quote with a 3rem avatar. Spacers are 4rem / 3rem <=991 / 2rem <=767.

theme.note: light = #fafefe band with dark text; dark = page background.

evidenceNotes: Heading is passed as a 3-part array [before, italic, after]; 'Nova connect' passes an empty italic part (['Nova ', '', 'connect']), so it has no emphasis.
Six instances on one page: the first is rendered explicitly with a quote, the other five via BLOCKS.map with quote={null}.
Layout knobs not modelled: inset, wide (3-col grid style), media width/aspect/placement/rounded/center/mb, endSpacer, header/body/grid class overrides.
The section is named spring-grid in code (data-section="spring-grid"); this contract calls it product.release-block.
